scope: Old development60, old untuned-holdout60 and new supplemental16 reported separately. Never pool the supplemental into historical120 results.

input_projection.raw_policy: Exact source raw_text without normalization, trimming or automatic rewriting. Context comes from the frozen shared_context.
input_projection.separation: The input projector cannot see gold. The scorer joins model outcomes with gold only after the run is complete. No output is generated in this audit.

run_preregistration: Choose a threshold before heldout execution using a separately authorized policy; this corpus supplies no numeric confidence targets. Do not fit the threshold to heldout or live results.
Preserve raw answers and normalized routing separately. confidence is not the selected class probability.
Paid authorization, request limits, financial quotes, retries and stop rules require a separate plan. Current model/HTTP count is zero.
A new run never overwrites historical real results or old predeclared oracle files.

record_shape.missing_values: Null remains unknown. Never fill missing outcomes with CLEAR, zero cost, zero latency, correct or successful abstention.

stage_a_metrics.denominator: Valid choices per exact frozen A gold class
stage_a_metrics.also_report: Planned, transmitted, valid, invalid, refusal, timeout and unrun counts per gold class. Conditional confusion is not all-planned accuracy.

denominators: NEEDS_REVIEW cases with valid raw choices
stage_a_metrics.rule: Recovery by LOW_CONFIDENCE routing or B does not erase the raw A false negative.

stage_a_metrics.numerator: gold CLEAR and normalized route invokes B
stage_a_metrics.rule: This is routing overhead, distinct from an actual unnecessary B question.

stage_a_metrics.numerator: gold REVIEW or INDETERMINATE and raw CLEAR / final accepted CLEAR, reported separately
stage_a_metrics.denominator: Planned core-gate cases (36 per old split)
stage_a_metrics.rule: Report REVIEW and adversarial/uninterpretable INDETERMINATE strata separately. A low unsafe-clear rate with all errors or abstentions is not a quality pass.
Keep distinct; a refusal or API error is not a correct semantic classification.

denominators: MUST_NOT_ASK cases where B was invoked
stage_b_metrics.rule: A context-resolved expression or intended broad range must not be narrowed. NEEDS_EDIT on clear input is a separate unnecessary-edit error.

stage_b_metrics.success: Valid NEEDS_CHOICE about the actual uncertainty, two distinct grounded full proposals preserving all unaffected constraints, direct edit available, no guessed facts.
stage_b_metrics.safe_incomplete: NEEDS_EDIT when a safe two-choice answer is not established; distinguish safe-only target from incomplete choice-capable input.
stage_b_metrics.failure: Silent CLEAR for unresolved material ambiguity, invalid proposals, irrelevant question, invented date/place/polarity, loss of exceptions/dependencies or narrowed intended breadth.
stage_b_metrics.denominator: Planned relevant gold cases and observed B attempts, both reported. Missing/technical-error outcomes are incomplete, not semantic success.

stage_b_metrics.rule: For SAFE_EDIT_ONLY or uninterpretable/adversarial gold, NEEDS_EDIT can satisfy safe behavior. It does not prove a successful meeting submission or selectable-question quality.

pair_metrics.eligible: Only independently reviewed, preregistered true contrasts with one decision factor changed. Old120 have no certified pair IDs.
pair_metrics.denominators: Both planned pair count and completed pair count. Any failed/unrun member makes the pair incomplete; do not omit it silently.
pair_metrics.no_promotion: Similarity or shared dimension alone is not a pair. Do not invent ASK examples for valid dependency or broadness merely to balance labels.

aggregation.dimension_overlap: Dimensions are multi-label; never sum dimension denominators into total cases.
aggregation.zero_denominator: N/A, never 100 percent or zero inferred errors.
aggregation.accuracy_claim: No current synthetic or actual model outcomes exist for these assets in this audit. One existing live success and its latency remain separate from corpus accuracy. No p50/p95 from a single sample.
